mapper.select: SELECT mp.id, mp.student_id AS studentId, sp.real_name AS studentName, mp.teacher_id AS teacherId, tp.real_name AS teacherName, mp.apply_time AS applyTime, mp.match_status AS matchStatus, sp.free_time AS studentFreeTime, sp.grade AS studentGrade FROM match_pair mp LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = mp.student_id LEFT JOIN teacher_profile tp ON tp.user_id = mp.teacher_id WHERE mp.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND mp.match_status = 0 ORDER BY mp.apply_time DESC
